correctness.rationale: The independent alternating-side construction proves the exact reduction. A full first coupon draw is forced new, so deletion of this first step exactly models the known starting vertex. The balanced strict comparison equals one half plus one half the tie mass. The identity m p_m(k+1)=P(U_{m,k}=1), Poisson factorial moments, local compact convergence and boundedness give m times the tie mass tending to 1/4. Classical independent coupon Gumbels give the logistic window under the stated relative size hypotheses. Exact independent Markov-state checks match rational formulas for all 64 pairs with 1<=a,b<=8; 158 checks in packaged source. No finite calculation is substituted for an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural complete bipartite cover-tour problem is fully reduced to a computable rational law, and a nontrivial finite balance correction of 1/(8n) is obtained together with a logistic critical part-size window. This gives location-specific information beyond the previously studied binary uniformity classification and clarifies the impact of parity and starting-vertex precoverage.
